a: Elisabeth Elliot (1926–2015) yafuuka nnamwandu bba we Jim n'abalala bana bwe battibwa Waorani ab'e Ecuador — n'alyoka agenda okubeera wamu n'abantu abo bennyini abaamutta, ng'alaba bangi nga bajja eri Kristo. Okuyita mu myaka mingi egy'okuwandiika n'okuyigiriza ku kubonaabona n'okugondera, yafuuka omu ku maloboozi agasinga okwesigibwa mu Bakristaayo ab'enjiri ab'ekyasa eky'amakumi abiri, era ajjukirwa olw'ebigambo bisatu ebyangu eri buli atalaba ngeri ya kweyongerayo: "kola ekintu ekiddako."

Yazaalibwa nga Elisabeth Howard nga 21 December 1926 mu Brussels, abazadde be gye baali baweereza ng'ababaka b'enjiri, era yakulira mu maka agaali gategekeddwa okwetooloola Ebyawandiikibwa n'okusaba. Yasoma Oluyonaani olw'edda mu Wheaton College — si ku bwalwo, naye kubanga yali ayagala okuvvuunula Bayibuli eri abantu abaali batannagifuna — era n'eyeeyongera okutendekebwa mu Prairie Bible Institute. Mu Wheaton yasisinkana Jim Elliot; enkolagana yaabwe ey'okwegomba yamanyibwa olw'okuba ntono era nga tetuluvu, era tebaafumbiriganwa okutuusa nga bombi bali mu Ecuador, ku lunaku Jim lwe yazaalirwa mu 1953.

Jim n'ababaka b'enjiri abalala bana baali bamaliridde okutuukirira Waorani, abaamanyibwanga mu kiseera ekyo n'erinnya erivvoola nti "Auca" era abaatiibwanga olw'okutta abagwira. Baasooka okwatagana nga bali mu bbanga, ne basuula ebirabo, era ne bakka ku katundu k'omusenyu ku mabbali g'omugga Curaray; okumala ennaku ntono kyalabika ng'ekikola, n'oluvannyuma nga 8 January 1956 bonna abataano ne bafumitibwa amafumu ne battibwa. Elisabeth yali wa myaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda, ng'alina muwala ow'emyezi kkumi, amangwago ng'afuuse nnamwandu mu kibira eky'abagwira — era okutta teyakutwala ng'enkomerero y'obubaka, wabula, mu ngeri emu, ng'ekitundu ku bwo.

Wano olugero luva ku nnaku, bangi gye basobola okuteebereza, ne lutuuka ku kusalawo kumpi tewali n'omu asobola. Mu kifo ky'okuddayo eka, Elisabeth yasigala mu Ecuador, era mu October 1958 n'agenda okubeera wamu ne Waorani bennyini, ng'atwala muwala we Valerie — mu kiseera ekyo nga wa myaka nga esatu — mu kibiina ekyamufuula nnamwandu, era n'eyegattibwako Rachel Saint, mwannyina w'omuvuzi w'ennyonyi eyattibwa ku musenyu. Abantu baamuwa erinnya mu lulimi lwabwe: Gikari, ekinyonyi ekikonkona emiti.

Yabeera ne Waorani okutuusa mu 1961, era mu kiseera ekyo — nga mu 1960 — bangi ku bo bajja mu kukkiriza Kristo. Yali amaze emyaka ng'asaba okubawa ebigambo by'Ebyawandiikibwa; naye Katonda yamuwa omulimu omuzibu okusinga: okubawa okubeerawo kwe ku bubwe, nga talina byokulwanyisa era ng'asonyiwa, mu kifo kyennyini we baattira bba, n'aleka ekyo kibeere okubuulira ng'ebigambo eby'okusoma tebinnabaawo. Kino kye kiddaabo ekisinga obwangu ebyawandiikibwa bye biganya: si nti okubonaabona kwe kwannyonnyolwa, wabula nti tekwali kwa bwereere.

q: Ye ne Rachel Saint baali ttiimu etaaliimu kwawukana?
a: Kyandivvunudde olugero singa abakazi ababiri bafuulibwa ekibiina eky'abatukuvu ekitaliimu kwawukana; tebaali bwe batyo. Elisabeth ne Rachel Saint baawukana mu mpisa, mu kutegeera Katonda ne mu ngeri y'okukola, era enkaayana wakati waabwe yali ya nnamaddala era yawandiikibwa mu bwesigwa. Abakazi ababiri ab'amaanyi, abanakuwavu, buli omu ng'akakasa okuyitibwa kwe, nga babeera wamu n'abaali batemu, tebaakkiriziganya bulijjo ku ngeri omulimu gye gwandikoleddwa — era nti baagumiikiriza wadde nga bwe kityo, era nti Waorani baawulira enjiri okuyita mu bo, kikkirizibwa okusinga olw'obuzibu obwo, si kikendeezebwa.

Yafuuka omu ku bawandiisi Abakristaayo abaasinga okwesigibwa mu kyasa kye, nga yeesigibwa nnyo kubanga teyalimba ku bulumi. Yawandiika Through Gates of Splendor (1957), ebyafaayo by'abasajja abataano; Shadow of the Almighty (1958), ebyaggibwa mu bitabo bya Jim eby'ennyiriri; The Savage My Kinsman (1961) ku Waorani; era oluvannyuma Passion and Purity, A Chance to Die (ekifaananyi kye ekya Amy Carmichael), The Path of Loneliness, ne Keep a Quiet Heart. Okuva mu 1988 okutuuka mu 2001 eddoboozi lye lyatuuka mu maka buli lunaku okuyita mu pulogulaamu ya leediyo Gateway to Joy.

Wakati w'ebyo bye yayigiriza kwe kwewaayo — kye yayita okuleka, okukwasa Katonda okwagala kwo — era amagezi ge gaali ga butereevu era nga tegalimu kusaasirira kwa bwereere: kkiriza okubonaabona, weebaze Katonda ku kyo, era okiddize Ye. Si kukinnyonnyola, si kukiddukako, so si na kukitegeera. Kkiriza, weebaza, waayo. Yali akoze ekyo kyennyini ku mabbali g'omugga mu 1956, era teyali agenda kuwa balala ddagala lye yali agaanye okumira. N'obufumbo bwe oluvannyuma lwa Jim bwamanya ennaku — yafuuka nnamwandu nate mu 1973 — era ekyo kyakaza obubaka bwe ne bufuuka ekintu ekiyinza okukozesebwa.

q: Yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti "kola ekintu ekiddako"?
a: Ge gaali amagezi ge yawa abantu abatabalika abaali baziyizibwa ennaku oba entiisa oba obunene bw'olunaku oluzibu, era yali afaayo bulijjo okugawa ekitiibwa eri oluyimba olw'edda olutamanyiddwa muwandiisi waalwo mu kifo ky'okwefuula nti ye yagakola. Amagezi gaalwo ge magezi gennyini ag'okudda: ekkubo lyonna bwe liba nga lya kizikiza nnyo okulaba, tosabibwa kulaba kkubo lyonna — osabibwa kukola ekintu ekiddako. Buli pulogulaamu yagitandikanga n'amazima agagenda nago: "Oyagalibwa n'okwagala okutaliggwaawo ... era wansi w'oli emikono egitaggwaawo."

Yalekera awo okwogera mu lujjudde mu 2004 ng'obulwadde bw'okwerabira bweyongera, era yamala nga myaka kkumi egyasembayo mu kasirise kaabwo akawanvu, n'afiira eka mu Magnolia, Massachusetts, nga 15 June 2015, ng'alina emyaka kinaana mu munaana. By'aleka si nkola njawulo era si kyamagero kimu, wabula obunnyonnyofu — obwakolebwa n'omubiri gwe yennyini mu kibira ekyaddala, mu maaso g'abatemu ab'amazima — nti enjiri etegeeza kye yogera, n'ebintu bibiri bye yagaba: nti oyagalibwa n'okwagala okutaliggwaawo, era, eri buli atalaba ngeri ya kweyongerayo, ekiragiro so si nsengeka ya birowoozo. Kola ekintu ekiddako.
